statusText: Mapped policy state: ON. NDX has substantially repaired the cash-open selloff, returning above the prior close after rebounding roughly 175 points from the session low. The wide range and geopolitical backdrop keep Stress extreme, but current price-path evidence is two-sided rather than persistently one-way.
recommendation: Current Tail is 18%. The mapped policy state is ON; the earlier downside extension has mean-reverted materially, while Consumer Credit at 19:00 UTC remains a scheduled WATCH checkpoint rather than current Tail evidence.
headline: Tail falls to low as NDX repairs the opening selloff and regains the prior close
body: NDX was 29,576.17 at 11:37:51 ET, up 0.11%, after trading between 29,400.70 and 29,655.73 from a 29,645.18 open. The roughly 175-point recovery from the low restored the index above its 29,544.16 prior close. Oil, yields and Middle East risk keep Stress extreme, while chip strength adds a counterweight to broader-market weakness.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hour slots, published ChatGPT Tail ranged from 17% to 32% and Stress from 95% to 100%. The 14:00 UTC cash-open slot reached 32% on downside extension, then the 15:00 slot eased to 23% as meaningful repair developed.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is low after the cash-session decline substantially repaired. The next scheduled WATCH checkpoint is Consumer Credit at 19:00 UTC. Overnight Tail remains low under an orderly two-sided base case; tomorrow's Employer Costs release raises Stress, while higher Tail still requires observed persistent repricing.
